title: Mario and the princess in the castle.
lines: In the Mushroom Kingdom everything is happy and colourful.
There are green hills, big mushrooms and gold coins floating in the air.
Mario lives there.
Mario is a plumber.
He wears a red cap, blue dungarees and he has a big moustache.
He can jump really high.
Hup!
He lives with his brother Luigi.
Luigi is taller and wears a green cap.
One morning a little mushroom comes running up.
It's Toad.
He has a white hat with red spots.
Mario!
Mario!
shouts Toad.
Something terrible has happened!
Bowser has taken Princess Peach to his castle!
Bowser is a big turtle with spikes on his back.
He can breathe fire and he roars very loudly.
But really he is mostly a bit lonely and jealous.
Don't worry, Toad, says Mario.
I'll go and get the princess!
Let's go!
Mario straightens his cap and sets off.
First he has to cross the green land.
Little brown mushrooms are walking around, the Goombas.
They're angry and they want to stop him.
But Mario jumps over them.
Hup, hup, hup!
Then he sees a block with a question mark on it.
Ping!
Mario bumps it with his head.
A red mushroom comes out.
Mario eats it and, wow, he becomes big and strong!
Then Mario has to go through a long green pipe.
He slides down, whoosh, and comes out in a dark cave under the ground.
There are lots of gold coins there.
Ping, ping, ping!
Mario collects them all.
From the cave he comes to a big lake.
How is he going to get across?
Then he hears a happy sound.
It's Yoshi, the green dinosaur with the long tongue.
Yoshi!
calls Mario.
Will you help me?
Yoshi nods.
Mario jumps on his back and Yoshi runs across the stones in the water.
Hop, hop, hop, all the way to the other side.
There stands Bowser's castle.
It's dark and grey, and all around it is hot lava.
High up in the tower Mario sees Princess Peach.
She's wearing a pink dress and a little gold crown.
She waves.
Mario!
Mario thanks Yoshi and goes into the castle.
There are long staircases and fireballs flying around.
Mario jumps and dives.
At last he comes to the great hall.
There stands Bowser.
Graaaw!
roars Bowser.
The princess is staying with me!
Why did you take her?
asks Mario.
Bowser looks at the floor.
Because nobody ever comes to my castle, he grumbles.
Everyone always goes to the princess's party.
And I'm never invited.
Princess Peach hears it.
Oh Bowser, she says softly.
If you had just asked, I would have invited you.
But you can't just take someone away.
That's not nice.
Bowser sighs.
Sorry, he mumbles.
Mario sees a big button on the floor.
He jumps on it.
Click!
The tower door opens.
Princess Peach comes down.
Thank you, Mario!
That evening there's a big party at the princess's castle.
There's cake and music and lights.
Luigi is there, and Toad, and Yoshi.
And who is standing by the door, a little shy?
Bowser!
With a present in his big claws.
Come on in, says the princess.
Bowser smiles.
Everyone dances, and Mario jumps for joy as high as he can.
Wahoo!
The end.
